propositions: The _rebar_repo_template fixture asserts absence of .rebar directory but does not assert the template carries no tickets.
The no-tickets invariant is checked only in a separate test (test_template_stays_virgin), which does not protect narrowed test runs (e.g., pytest tests/interfaces/store).
The missing assertion must execute inside the MonkeyPatch context where REBAR_ROOT and cwd are pinned at the template, immediately after rebar.init_repo() and the root commit.
Pre-seeding the template with tickets would silently invert session-log count assertions that currently depend on template emptiness.
Fixture-level assertion enforcement fires once per worker before any test runs and protects all consumers, whereas test-level checks fire only when that specific test is selected.
